holdout.note: the only causal read: arms assigned by hash on 2026-08-19 from buckets 00-3; 'advanced' = current bucket rank > rank at assignment. The hold arm is n=40, so any lift under ~10 points is inside the noise.

recommendations.title: Report-call-b56: first ask same day to every new b5 owner; cap follow-ups at 2
recommendations.why: walkthrough-scheduler-v2 (first ask) booked ~18 calls on 48 sends (n<100, directional); the follow-up template booked ~5 on ~306 sends to ~76 owners (~4 each). Report calls are the only booking that predicts a listing.
recommendations.change: outreach/report_call_bucket_send.py: limit walkthrough-scheduler-v2-followup to 2 per address; RC_CAP=25 in ~/.openclaw/agents/reportcall-b56.sh is not binding — leave it. Keep the lane green (FAILING exit 2 at 13:45 on 2026-11-10, recovered by 14:20).
recommendations.expected: ~23 inspections/mo -> ~5.3 new b5/wk x ~0.35 = ~1.9 report bookings/wk vs ~1.3/wk observed Aug-Oct: +0.6/wk
recommendations.risk: b5 converts by phone; Gabriel's calls drive some of these bookings, so 0.35 is an upper bound. Keep the 5-day cross-engine gap with consult-inspection.

recommendations.title: Answer the Gmail replies nobody answered
recommendations.why: 26 Gmail replies in the last 7 days have no later send to that address.
recommendations.change: python3 -m outreach.engagement_watch --report, then the reply-responder agent (logistics auto-send only; price/contract held for Gabriel)
recommendations.expected: one-time ~1-3 bookings if ~10% are bookable (the 10-22 check found most replies were declines)
recommendations.risk: replying to declines/opt-outs; read each thread first

recommendations.title: Consult-inspection: hold volume, stop crediting its report bookings
recommendations.why: first touch 14 bookings on 244 (57.4/1k); re-touch 16 on 756 (21.2/1k), but >=8 of the report-call credits went to owners already in bucket 4 at send, i.e. the inspection was booked before the email.
recommendations.change: no cap change (INSPECTION_CAP=200 in com.belong.inspection-adoption-enqueue.plist is not binding); in scripts/enqueue_inspection_consult.py re-check the live bucket at send time so b4+ owners drop out
recommendations.expected: ~16 first touches/wk x ~0.058 = ~0.9 bookings/wk, unchanged; removes stage-mismatched sends
recommendations.risk: COOLOFF_DAYS=14 re-touches signed owners; opt-outs from bucket 3 are the costliest

recommendations.title: apmg-t1: widen source scope to the remaining inbound sources
recommendations.why: best first-touch rate in the book: 27 bookings on 349 (77.4/1k) and the most inspections_after per send. Supply-limited; the cap is irrelevant.
recommendations.expected: ~12 extra SQLs since 10-01 in those sources = ~2/wk x ~0.08 = +0.15 bookings/wk
recommendations.risk: Intercom consent + current-customer pass on each new source; consult lane also touches SQLs (5-day gap); t1 opens cold, wrong for a signup Gabriel just phoned

recommendations.title: Cut drain-backfill tier B
recommendations.why: last 30d 772 sends -> 2 bookings (2.6/1k); since 09-09 ~11 bookings on ~4,900 sends, indistinguishable from the organic rate on a pool that large.
recommendations.risk: drain idles when the queue is empty — that is the honest state

recommendations.title: Keep funnel-cadence off and fix its insert path before any re-enable
recommendations.why: t4-t6: 1 booking on 383 sends; it inserts status='sent' directly, bypassing the holdout trigger — 19 of 40 holdout addresses were emailed by t4-t6.
recommendations.change: leave com.belong.funnel-cadence.plist.disabled; also drop llc-network (0 on 172) and multiunit (0 on 237) from future plans

caveats: bookings come from engagement_signals + calendar_booked.txt matched on email and name; 281 distinct bookings since 2026-06-01, 143 had a sent email in the 21 days before the call, 138 did not (organic/inbound or booked under an address we never emailed); 44 name-only bookings never resolved to an address.
booking dates are the CALL date, not the date the owner clicked the link, so a send between booking and call can collect the credit (inflates every lane slightly).

replies = inbound Gmail replies only; 557 'CRM: replied/asked for callback' flags are excluded because the snapshot has no inbound/outbound direction. Replies include declines and auto-replies that slipped the filter.
advanced / agreements_after / inspections_after use the CRM's CURRENT-cycle *_effective_dt dates only; a milestone that was later reset or re-cycled is lost.

bucket_at_send = bucket in the nearest dated CRM snapshot at or before the send (<=7 days old; snapshots start 2026-07-08), else the holdout bucket_at_assign, else null. Most cold/backfill recipients are not in Gabriel's book and read null.
replies_pending_answer = Gmail replies in the last 7 days with no later send to that address; a phone answer or hand reply outside the send log is invisible here.
per-1k figures beside n < 100 sends are marked too_small and should not be read.
November is partial (through the generation date) and the lanes were down 2026-11-06 to 11-10 for the dashboard-cookie outage.
